title: Repository and team setup
user_story: As a contributor I can run the project and submit a reviewed change.
acceptance_criteria: All confirmed members can clone, run and push a branch; one small reviewed PR each; README names runtime and commands.

title: Student application shell
user_story: As a student I can identify DDP and navigate its main views.
acceptance_criteria: DDP/Dal branding and existing logo; responsive sidebar/mobile drawer; four views with hash navigation, skip link and help; compare reference keyboard/mobile paths.

title: Scope and source authority
user_story: As a project team we know which curriculum and users we support.
acceptance_criteria: Client questions logged; BACS intake year and source approver requested; unresolved assumptions visible; scope decisions linked.

title: Reference curriculum contract and seed data
user_story: As a student I can see course data with source and review status.
acceptance_criteria: Use reference course IDs and curriculum shape (revision, updatedAt, courses, rules, ruleSources, degree); preserve source-year and unknown/reviewed-empty distinctions; no live timetable feed.

title: Searchable course explorer
user_story: As a student I can find a course by code or title.
acceptance_criteria: Case-insensitive code/title search, category and level filters, hide-planned option, active-course filtering and empty state match the reference.

title: Course details and official links
user_story: As a student I can inspect requirements and reach official sources.
acceptance_criteria: Details show credits, reviewed rule text/status and source year; calendar/timetable links work; dialog closes with focus restored.

title: Accessible multi-year term planner
user_story: As a student I can add, move and remove a course without logging in.
acceptance_criteria: Four-year Fall/Winter grid, optional Summer and all-years view; labelled example and confirmed blank reset; add/move/remove and grade controls; move does not duplicate or discard an existing grade; term totals update.

title: Local saving and recovery
user_story: As a student I can return to my plan in this browser.
acceptance_criteria: Reload restores plan; storage failure shows feedback without losing in-memory edits; invalid stored data handled; browser-only limitation stated.

title: Versioned JSON export
user_story: As a student I can keep a portable backup.
acceptance_criteria: Export matches reference version:1/isExample/entries courseId-termId-grade format and filename; blank grade is an empty string; reference and rebuilt exports cross-import.

title: Validated plan import
user_story: As a student I can restore a saved plan safely.
acceptance_criteria: Valid cross-import preserves entries; malformed/over-1MB/unsupported-version/unknown-ID/invalid-grade/duplicate input rejected; cancellation or failure preserves current plan; replacement confirmed.

title: Student slice review and QA
user_story: As a director I can demonstrate completed student outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Search→details→add→move→reload→export/import executed on release commit; defects linked; individual work pushed before Oct. 11.

title: AND/OR prerequisites and chronology
user_story: As a student I can identify courses planned before their prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: All groups required; any alternative can satisfy its group; earlier term required unless concurrent allowed; missing/unknown cases visible; synthetic tests cover branches.

title: Grades and co-requisites
user_story: As a student I can distinguish pending from earned eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: C and C+ thresholds compared correctly in synthetic tests; blank grade is pending; below minimum blocks; co-requisite allows same term only where reviewed rule permits.

title: Checks panel and workload guidance
user_story: As a student I can understand what to change in my plan.
acceptance_criteria: Issues identify course/term and reason in text; fix recalculates promptly; workload warning labelled guidance; no unsupported graduation guarantee.

title: Dependency map
user_story: As a student I can explore ancestors and dependent courses.
acceptance_criteria: Selected course highlights reachable prerequisites/dependents; traversal terminates on cycles; unknown rules visible; keyboard course buttons and text list available.

title: Requirement progress
user_story: As a student I can distinguish planned coverage from earned credit.
acceptance_criteria: Match reference planned category/option progress, earned-credit summary and elective guidance; preserve warnings that counts do not establish graduation eligibility; no new full elective audit.

title: Drag/drop with alternative controls
user_story: As a student I can quickly rearrange courses.
acceptance_criteria: Drop adds/moves only a valid course to a valid term; credits/checks update; labelled add/move controls remain usable by keyboard/touch.

title: Admin hosting and API contract
user_story: As a maintainer I know how admin changes persist.
acceptance_criteria: FCS runtime/storage/HTTPS confirmed or blocker recorded; API/schema/error/version contract and hosting ADR reviewed; no assumption that static hosting runs a server.

title: Admin authentication and authorization
user_story: As an authorized admin I can access editing tools.
acceptance_criteria: Server verifies credentials with appropriate password hashing and protected sessions; unauthorized writes denied; session/logout and CSRF controls tested; credentials excluded from frontend/repo.

title: Course admin editing
user_story: As an admin I can add, edit and archive a course.
acceptance_criteria: All reference course fields, fixed code on edit, search and active/archived/all filters supported; create/edit/archive/restore validated server-side; save persists across restart; shared curriculum, stale-edit protection and activity history match.

title: Degree and rule admin editing
user_story: As an admin I can maintain approved requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Match reference reviewed/unknown rule toggle, AND/OR groups, grade/timing/source fields and degree/group/elective editing; revision conflicts visible; invalid totals/fields denied; saves appear in activity history.

title: Preserve and review reference data coverage
user_story: As a student I know which rules have been verified.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve existing catalogue and clearly labelled review gaps; verify sources for changed records; document coverage; no new transfer/elective audit or invented C+ rule.

title: Usability and accessibility review
user_story: As a student I can use the main flows on a narrow screen and keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Agreed student tasks observed; focus/dialog/labels/status messages checked; issues prioritized and fixed or documented; feedback identifies build used.

title: Deployment and regression
user_story: As a stakeholder I can use a stable release candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Clean build/applicable tests; actual host-path smoke check; student fallback when API unavailable; VITE_FRONTEND_ONLY=true static build has bundled data and disabled admin; full backend restart/persistence/restore tested when available; parity results recorded.

title: Presentation and demonstration
user_story: As a stakeholder I can understand delivered results.
acceptance_criteria: Date/rubric confirmed; timed rehearsal completed; demo matches release and has fallback; every member contribution represented truthfully.

title: Executable and acceptance package
user_story: As a non-technical stakeholder I can open and test the product.
acceptance_criteria: Release/tag, start guide, acceptance steps and known issues supplied; another person follows install; actual acceptance outcomes recorded; package submitted Dec. 9.

title: Handover and individual declarations
user_story: As a client I receive materials and maintenance knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Six reviewed declarations, repo/release/docs/access inventory, walkthrough and acknowledgement recorded; open work assigned; exact deadline confirmed.

title: Live timetable availability integration
user_story: As a student I can see synchronized offerings if a supported source exists.
acceptance_criteria: Supported source/permission and refresh semantics agreed; stale/error states visible; term coverage tested; no scraping assumption.

title: Transfer/repeat/equivalence audit
user_story: As a student I can model more complex academic cases.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor-approved semantics and fixtures precede implementation; repeated attempts and equivalents avoid double credit; exclusions reported.

title: PDF plan export
user_story: As a student I can share a readable plan document.
acceptance_criteria: Printable plan includes terms/credits/check limitations and source version; long labels remain readable; JSON backup still supported.
